Thanks — quick commercial notes from finance: 

- 50/50 prepay model: acceptable. We recommend an explicit clause: "Unused prepaid credits will roll forward quarter-to-quarter for up to two quarters; thereafter remaining credits convert to service credit with 50% reimbursement value." This avoids open-ended liability on Redwood.
- Invoice cadence: propose monthly invoices for consumed credits and one prepay invoice at T0 for tranche 1, tranche 2 invoiced on the earlier of (i) start of quarter 2 or (ii) usage above 75% of tranche 1 within 45 days.
- Net terms: net45 is doable but increases short-term cash runway exposure. We can accept Net45 for year one with a 0.5% price uplift as Mina suggested. Add an optional early-payment 1% discount if FinHealth pays within 15 days.
- Tax: We will attach the signed Redwood vendor residency (PDF). If FinHealth requires a stronger form (notarized), we'll escalate.

Suggested edits (bullets to incorporate into Order Form):
- Define "Tranche Release Event" with 3 objective triggers (calendar date, usage threshold, mutual acceptance).
- Add "Credit Reallocation" table into Exhibit B (limits and timeline).
- Add a tax-residency deliverable timeline: Redwood provides residency cert within 3 business days after countersign; sample invoice within 3 business days after countersign.
